help.title: Help
help.intro: Record over a backing track, layer harmonies, then polish the sound.

tips.headphones: Wear headphones while recording so the music stays out of your vocal.
tips.punchIn: Click a spot on the timeline, then record to sing over just that part.
tips.edit: Drag a clip to move it, its edges to trim, and its top corners to fade.
tips.sweetSpot: The green notch under each Polish slider marks our suggested setting.
tips.selectClips: Drag across an empty part of the timeline to select several clips; ⌘-click adds one. Group them from the Edit menu, or right-click, to keep them together. Drag clips up or down to move them to another track.
tips.moveTracks: Drag a track by its name to move it up or down.
tips.selectTracks: ⌘-click or ⇧-click track names to select several, then mute or remove them together.
tips.tuning: Turn up Tuning in Polish to pull notes into the song’s key. Rove hears the key from the music.
tips.music: Select the music track to change its speed or key.
tips.chords: Open Chords to see the music’s chords as it plays; click one to jump there.
tips.lyrics: Open Lyrics to search for the words. They follow along as you sing; click a line to jump there.
